entwurf.thema: AI‑Driven Quant Factor Mining with Qlib RD‑Agent
entwurf.beschreibung: Learn how Qlib’s open‑source RD‑Agent automates factor discovery, speeds up back‑testing, and what data requirements you must meet.

teile.name: Hook
teile.bildtext: A trader staring at a wall of missed signals
teile.szene: A dimly lit office, a trader eyes flicker over a cluttered desk. Light falls across spreadsheets and code. The atmosphere feels urgent, with a single laptop glowing in the corner. The room hums with the low buzz of a computer fan. A stack of printouts lies beside the keyboard, each showing potential but unused trading factors.
teile.text: Finding a solid trading factor feels endless, and every missed signal hurts your portfolio in real.

teile.name: Problem
teile.bildtext: Data scientist scanning code on a monitor
teile.szene: A bright lab, a data scientist sits at a sleek desk, eyes glued to a large monitor. Lines of code scroll across the screen, punctuated by graphs that pulse with data. The scientist’s face is illuminated by the screen’s glow, a focused expression set against a backdrop of whiteboards filled with equations. The room hums softly with the whir of cooling fans, adding to the intensity of the research atmosphere.
teile.text: RD‑Agent from Qlib steps in, scanning data to uncover patterns you’d otherwise overlook in just seconds.

teile.name: Setup
teile.szene: In a minimalist workspace, a developer’s fingers dance across a keyboard, typing commands. The screen shows the terminal with a pip install command, followed by a git clone. The background is a plain wall, focused solely on the glowing screen. The atmosphere is quiet, punctuated only by the rhythmic clicking of keys as the developer prepares the environment for the next step.
teile.text: Install Qlib via pip, clone the RD‑Agent repo, and run the demo script on your data.

teile.name: Result
teile.szene: A large screen displays colorful line charts. Each line represents a discovered factor, with markers indicating predictive power. A bar graph overlays the lines, ranking factors by stability. The visual is crisp, with bright colors contrasting against a dark background. The viewer sees an immediate sense of discovery, as the chart fills with data points that signify new opportunities for trading strategies.
teile.text: The agent then returns dozens of candidate factors, each scored by predictive power and stability.

teile.name: Apply
teile.bildtext: Trader exporting CSV and loading model
teile.szene: A trader sits at a desk, clicking a button to export a CSV file. The file icon appears on the screen, followed by a line of code that loads the CSV into a model. The background shows a monitor with a graph plotting back‑test results. The room is bright, the focus on the data transfer and the anticipation of improved performance.
teile.text: Export these factors as CSV, feed them into your model, and compare back‑test results today.

teile.name: Limitation
teile.bildtext: Broken data loader with error message
teile.szene: An error dialog pops up on a screen, flashing red text. The message warns about missing historical price data. The background shows a cluttered file system with missing files, indicating that the data loader failed. The setting is a quiet office, with only the hum of the computer and the faint beep of an error. The viewer senses frustration, highlighting the need for complete data.
teile.text: Even with signals, incomplete price histories can trigger loading errors, so verify your dataset first.

teile.name: CTA
teile.bildtext: End screen with like share icons
teile.szene: The video fades to a clean screen with simple icons. A thumbs‑up, a share arrow, and a bookmark appear. The background is a soft gradient, drawing attention to the call to action. No text or logos are present, keeping focus on the viewer’s interaction.
teile.text: Be sure to like, share and save this video.
